_note: Disease threat tier for risk scoring. 15 of 18 disease classes have KB-derived tiers (all UNVERIFIED pending pathologist sign-off); Cedar apple rust, Esca, and Squash powdery mildew remain [GAP]. See plan.md I19, I26 and docs/review/threat_table_draft.md. Valid tiers: HEALTHY | LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH | DISEASE_DETECTED
_tier_scores_note: [ENG assumption] — all values to be calibrated by plant pathologist.

Apple___Apple_scab.notes: KB draft tier (HIGH) approved pending human pathologist sign-off (I19). Up to 100% loss without control.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.notes: Retained as GAP pending pathologist review; non-reinfecting single-cycle on apple with no Indian reports.

Apple___healthy.notes: Marked as healthy class by engineering based on class name.

Blueberry___healthy.notes: Marked as healthy class by engineering based on class name.

Cherry___healthy.notes: Marked as healthy class by engineering based on class name.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.notes: Marked as healthy class by engineering based on class name.

Corn___Cercospora_leaf_spot.notes: KB draft tier (MEDIUM) approved pending human pathologist sign-off (I19). Yield-limiting; not national priority.

Corn___Common_rust.notes: KB draft tier (MEDIUM) approved pending human pathologist sign-off (I19). Predominant late kharif; leaf tattering.

Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.notes: KB draft tier (HIGH) approved pending human pathologist sign-off (I19). 25-90% grain loss in epiphytotics.

Grape___Black_rot.notes: KB draft tier (MEDIUM) approved pending human pathologist sign-off (I19). National significance; mummified berries.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).notes: Retained as GAP; manual notes economic impact is difficult to measure and zero Indian loss data found.

Grape___healthy.notes: Marked as healthy class by engineering based on class name.

Peach___healthy.notes: Marked as healthy class by engineering based on class name.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.notes: KB draft tier (MEDIUM) approved pending human pathologist sign-off (I19). Main bacterial disease; defoliation & scabby fruit.

Pepper,_bell___healthy.notes: Marked as healthy class by engineering based on class name.

Potato___Early_blight.notes: KB draft tier (MEDIUM) approved pending human pathologist sign-off (I19). Dents tuber quality; mainly senescing plants.

Potato___Late_blight.notes: KB draft tier (HIGH) approved pending human pathologist sign-off (I19). Most destructive potato disease; 11-74% loss.

Potato___healthy.notes: Marked as healthy class by engineering based on class name.

Raspberry___healthy.notes: Marked as healthy class by engineering based on class name.

Soybean___healthy.notes: Marked as healthy class by engineering based on class name.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.notes: Retained as GAP; no KB chapter in data/knowledge_base/.

Strawberry___healthy.notes: Marked as healthy class by engineering based on class name.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.notes: KB draft tier (MEDIUM) approved pending human pathologist sign-off (I19). Older leaf defoliation and scabby fruit spots.

Tomato___Early_blight.notes: KB draft tier (MEDIUM) approved pending human pathologist sign-off (I19). 2nd most serious tomato disease; fruit rot.

Tomato___Late_blight.notes: KB draft tier (HIGH) approved pending human pathologist sign-off (I19). Fast-spreading blight; up to 79.5% loss.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.notes: KB draft tier (LOW) approved pending human pathologist sign-off (I19). Primarily polyhouse issue; fruit lesions uncommon.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.notes: KB draft tier (MEDIUM) approved pending human pathologist sign-off (I19). Severe defoliation; fruit rarely infected.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.notes: KB draft tier (HIGH) approved pending human pathologist sign-off (I19). Incurable vector-borne; up to 83% incidence.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.notes: Reviewer judgement call; incurable viral infection with severe shoestring and deformed fruit (I19).

Tomato___healthy.notes: Marked as healthy class by engineering based on class name.
